SCENE: Inside the Deltaris workshop. The dwarven master stands on a small wooden step stool beside the automaton, holding a tiny screwdriver, proud but now startled. He spent all night fitting an ornate brass shoulder plate onto the automaton, covered with dozens of tiny adjustment screws and small dials, tuned to fit while the automaton held one frozen pose with one arm raised. The automaton has just lowered its arm and taken one normal step: the over-tuned plate is coming loose and small screws and springs fly off in a little arc. The automaton looks down at its shoulder with a gentle apologetic expression. On the workbench behind them lies a simple plain steel shoulder plate with only two broad leather straps, untouched.

SCENE: On a flat stone rooftop terrace above the Deltaris harbor. SCENE: On the wooden deck of a small sailboat moored at the Deltaris harbor quay. The dwarven master sits on a barrel with an open leather ship log book on his knees, the pages showing only small hand-drawn sketches of clouds and waves (no writing). The automaton carefully adjusts the sail rigging with its brass fingers, following his instructions. Along the quay behind them, a row of several small moored boats each has a sail trimmed differently, as if the pair re-tuned the sail every season and kept each old version.
